status.submitted: We are reserving your items and taking payment…
status.paid: Paid. We will start preparing it soon.

cancel.title: Cancel this order?
cancel.body: The goods go back on the shelf and what you paid is refunded. This cannot be undone.
cancel.byYou: You cancelled this order. What you paid has been refunded.
cancel.byShop: The shop cancelled this order. What you paid has been refunded.

received.title: Did this parcel arrive?
received.body: Confirming starts the 7 days in which you can still return it; after them the seller is paid. It cannot be undone.
received.hint: If you do not confirm, the parcel is taken as received 7 days after it shipped.

return.title: Return this parcel?
return.body: Say what is wrong. The seller answers first; if they refuse, you can ask the shop to look again. Delivery is not refunded, and you pay to send it back.
return.until: You can ask to return it until {{at}}.
return.heading: Return

state.Requested: You asked to return this parcel on {{at}}. Waiting for {{who}} to answer.
state.Accepted: Your return was accepted. Send the parcel back by {{at}} and tell us its tracking reference.
state.AcceptedLate: Your return was accepted, but the time to send it back has passed.
state.Escalated: The shop’s staff are looking at your return again. Their answer is final.
state.Rejected: The shop’s staff turned the return down for good: {{reason}}
state.SentBack: On its way back ({{reference}}). You are refunded once it arrives.

return.sendBackBody: Enter the carrier’s tracking reference, so the seller can follow it.
return.sentBackDone: Thanks - the seller will mark it received when it arrives.
return.escalate: Ask the shop to look again
return.escalateTitle: Ask the shop to look again?
return.escalateBody: The shop’s staff read your reason and the seller’s, and decide. Their answer is final.
